Row {.tabset}

### Recruitment

```{r}
plot_trend(random_par$log_r, color = ~model, legendgroup = ~model, colors = cols, ylab = "Recruitment (r)")
```

### Recruitment deviations

```{r}
plot_trend(tabs$recruitment$residual, color = ~model, colors = cols,
            ylab = "Log recruitment deviation")
```

`r if ("log_n" %in% names(random_par)) "### N"`

```{r, eval = "log_n" %in% names(random_par)}
plot_age_year(random_par$log_n, color = ~model, legendgroup = ~model, colors = cols, frame = ~age, ylab = "Latent abundance (n)")
```

`r if ("N" %in% names(tabs$deviations)) "### N deviations"`

```{r, eval = "N" %in% names(tabs$deviations)}
plot_bubbles(tabs$deviations$N, res = ~est, frame = ~model, title = "N deviations")
```

`r if ("log_n0" %in% names(random_par)) "### Initial abundance"`

```{r, eval = "log_n0" %in% names(random_par)}
plot_trend(random_par$log_n0, x = ~age, xlab = "Age", color = ~model, legendgroup = ~model, colors = cols, ylab = "Initial abundance")
```

`r if ("log_f" %in% names(random_par)) "### F"`

```{r, eval = "log_f" %in% names(random_par)}
d <- random_par$log_f
if ("fleet" %in% names(d)) {
  d$state <- paste(d$fleet, "age", d$age)
  d$state <- factor(d$state, levels = unique(d$state[order(d$fleet, d$age)]))
  plot_trend(d, color = ~model, legendgroup = ~model, colors = cols, frame = ~state, ylab = "Latent F (f)")
} else plot_age_year(d, color = ~model, legendgroup = ~model, colors = cols, frame = ~age, ylab = "Latent F (f)")
```

`r if ("F" %in% names(tabs$deviations)) "### F deviations"`

```{r, eval = "F" %in% names(tabs$deviations)}
d <- tabs$deviations$F
if ("fleet" %in% names(d)) d$series <- interaction(d$model, d$fleet, sep = " / ", drop = TRUE)
plot_bubbles(d, res = ~est, frame = if ("series" %in% names(d)) ~series else ~model, title = "F deviations")
```

`r if ("log_m" %in% names(random_par)) "### M"`

```{r, eval = "log_m" %in% names(random_par)}
plot_trend(random_par$log_m, x = ~year, color = ~model, legendgroup = ~model, colors = cols, frame = ~age_block, ylab = "Latent M (m)")
```

`r if ("M" %in% names(tabs$deviations)) "### M deviations"`

```{r, eval = "M" %in% names(tabs$deviations)}
plot_bubbles(tabs$deviations$M, res = ~est, y = ~age_block, ylab = "M state block",
  frame = ~model, title = "M deviations")
```
